title: Textured Christmas pillow covers for a cozy sala
seoTitle: Christmas Pillow Covers Philippines 2026: Tufted, Plush and Faux Fur
dek: 7 hand-picked Christmas pillow covers with texture you can feel: tufted boucle, fluffy plush, embroidered trees, chenille and faux fur. No flat prints, and they pack flat after the season.
teaser: Tufted, plush and faux fur covers that make a small sala feel like Christmas.
description: Textured Christmas pillow covers in the Philippines: tufted boucle, plush, embroidered, chenille and faux fur Christmas tree covers for the sofa, with prices, sizes to check and care tips.

hero.alt: AI sample render of a condo sala with an oatmeal sofa and grey armchair styled with textured Christmas pillows: tufted candy canes, an embroidered tree, red plush, faux fur and green chenille

intro: Want your sala to feel like Christmas without a big tree or a big budget? Swap the pillow covers. It's the quickest, most affordable way to change the whole mood of a small condo sofa: zip off the everyday covers, zip on something festive, and you're done in five minutes. When the season ends, the covers fold flat and fit in a drawer, so they don't eat up storage the way bulky decor does.

We skipped flat prints and went for texture only: tufted, boucle, embroidered, plush, chenille and faux fur covers that look rich up close and feel cozy to lean on. We grouped them two ways: tufted, boucle and embroidered covers with raised designs, and soft plush and faux fur covers. These are covers only unless a listing says otherwise, so measure your inserts first. The Oct 30 payday and Lazada 11.11 are good times to pick up a pair or two.

tipGroups.title: Four tips for Christmas pillow covers

tips.title: Measure your insert first
tips.body: Most listings sell the cover only, so check the size of the cushions you already have (45 x 45 cm, or 18 x 18 inches, is a common size). A cover the same size or a little smaller than the insert looks fuller and plumper; a cover that's too big looks flat and baggy.

tips.title: Mix textures, keep the colors close
tips.body: Pair a fluffy or faux fur cover with a knit or embroidered one in the same reds, greens or creams. Different textures add depth, while matching colors keep a small sofa looking pulled together. Put bigger pillows at the back and smaller ones in front.
tips.source: Megafurniture: 5 festive decor ideas to transform your living room

tips.title: Keep plush away from candles
tips.body: Fluffy, plush and faux fur covers can catch fire. Keep lit candles away from pillows, throws and other decor, keep kids and pets away from them, and blow candles out when you leave the room or go to bed. LED candles give the same cozy glow with less worry.
tips.source: NFPA: Winter Holiday Safety tip sheet

tips.title: Wash gently, store flat
tips.body: Follow the care label: plush, tufted and faux fur covers usually do best with a gentle wash or spot cleaning. Let them dry fully, then fold them flat with a sachet in a box or drawer so they're ready for next Christmas.
